issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE 'python:3.12' is duplicated across Python and TypeScript instead of a single source of truth.
issues.detail: The constant lives in pipeline.py, the jinja template fallback, Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage fallback, and CellMetadataEditor.tsx. The RPC was added to centralize this, yet 3-4 hardcoded copies remain. A bump to python:3.13 will silently desync. Trust the RPC and delete the TS literals, or drop the RPC entirely.

issues.description: Silent behavior change in _set_base_image: empty-string fallback now pins python:3.12 instead of deferring to kfp's default.
issues.detail: Previously self.base_image = '' let kfp_dsl apply its own default when pod introspection failed. Now it forces python:3.12, overriding kfp's default for every affected user. The comment above still reads 'Use kfp default image'. This is a runtime semantic change sold as a UI display feature — split it out or document it explicitly.

issues.description: Repeated four-term fallback chain (step > pipeline > default > literal) is recomputed at multiple render sites with no shared helper.
issues.detail: The same precedence chain appears in InlineMetadata.createBaseImageText, the Dialog placeholder, Commands.ts, and the jinja template — sometimes in different order. Any precedence change requires lockstep edits across four sites. Resolve the effective image once (ideally server-side in compiler.py) and pass one resolved string down.

issues.description: Button width:'5%' labeled 'IMAGE' opening a modal is a UX regression versus the inline Input it replaced.
issues.detail: The previous UI was a directly-editable Input field. The new 5%-wide button cannot fit the word IMAGE at most viewport widths and adds an extra click for the common edit case. Either let MUI size to content with a clearer label like 'Edit Base Image', or restore the inline Input with placeholder helper text.

issues.description: Replacing the Input with a Button+Dialog plus three-level prop drilling is more framework than the feature warrants.
issues.detail: Adding Dialog/DialogTitle/DialogContent/DialogActions, a toggle handler, modal state, and threading defaultBaseImage + pipelineBaseImage through LeftPanel -> InlineCellsMetadata -> InlineMetadata/Editor is heavy machinery to display one default value. A context (already used for CellMetadata) or a single fetch at the leaf would collapse this; a placeholder on the original Input would have sufficed.

issues.description: RPC handler imports DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside the function body instead of at module top.
issues.detail: get_default_base_image does `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function with no circular-import justification. nb.py already imports from kale at the top level, and compiler.py follows the same convention. Move the import to the module header for clarity and minor perf.

synthesis.summary: The panel converges on NEEDS-WORK. Two P0 issues dominate: the python:3.12 constant is duplicated across Python and three TypeScript sites (defeating the new RPC's purpose), and pipeline.py silently changes runtime semantics by replacing the empty-string fallback (which deferred to kfp's default) with a hardcoded image — a behavior change disguised as a UI cosmetic. Beyond that, the same four-term fallback chain is reimplemented at multiple render sites, and the Button+Dialog with prop drilling is heavier machinery than the feature requires versus the original Input. Recommendation: single-source the constant, split the semantic change out of the display PR, and reconsider the UI regression.
